text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do our best at the Ramen 
Jamboree today! Ei, ei, Jamboree!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
"Jamboree!" "Jamboree! ...Looks like our 
call-and-responses grew again."

Today is finally the opening day of the 
Ramen Jamboree! Everyone, including <chrname>, 
seemed fully pumped up, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. This is drawing far bigger crowds 
than expected. The line is insane. Service 
speed isn't keeping up. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Fastest! Fastest! Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. In my panic, I ended up 
executing the forbidden "High-Speed Noodle 
Drain." I will reflect on this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I understand how you feel... Huh? 
Wait. Doesn't that noodle strainer have a 
hole in it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Is this all the seaweed we have? 
At this rate, we might run out!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so, so, so, so sooorrryyyy!! I 
messed up the order~~~!! Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'll go buy the noodle 
strainer and the nori!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then. —Heh.

Indeed, Tazuna-san's performance during 
this event was truly remarkable—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So, it seems we need to think about 
which company to rent the noodle boiler 
from...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, if it's about that... I just sent 
over the materials a moment ago, so please 
check them."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah! Amazing! Did you make a list of 
companies for me!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You expressed concern during our 
meeting the other day, after all. I just 
wanted to be of help!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a moment?
choice_data_list: Yes! What can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the 'Ramen Jamboree', the 
academy has also come up with some 
promotional ideas."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've put together about 10 proposals, so 
please look them over... I would truly 
appreciate your feedback!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always! I knew you've been 
gathering ingredients for our ramen 
research and helping set up events, but to 
go this far too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so grateful, truly... Once she 
returns, I must give her my thanks...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
After everything she's done for us, I have 
to... make sure to look after 
Tazuna-san...!

However, the nearest supermarket is quite 
far from this venue. It would take a 
considerable amount of time to get back—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Here are the nori seaweed and the noodle 
strainer! Please check them over!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That was a huge help, thank you so much. I 
will repay this favor someday—no, right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, right. I'm going to make staff ramen, 
so please eat up. Consider it a token of 
my gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah, thank you very much! Hehe, I'll 
enjoy it later, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Tazuna-san! Th-Th-Thank you sho sho 
much! ...So much~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Buying seaweed for us was wonderful too, 
but... you're always there, supporting us 
Umamusume from behind the scenes..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp! C-C-Could it be that just saying 
thank you isn't enough~~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No, please don't worry about it. 
It's something I want to do myself!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's the first time running this 
event! With things being unfamiliar, 
making mistakes is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, please rely on me—on 
us adults! That's what we're here for!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-Tazuna-san...!
choice_data_list:
(...I have to do my best too, just like 
her!)

(...I have to do my best too, just like 
her!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And now! Let's have everyone savor your 
lovely feelings to the fullest♪
